title: Rav Menashya bar Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bava Metzia 26a mentions Resh Lakish reporting Bar Kappara, then Rav Menashya bar Yaakov’s answer and Rav Nachman reporting Rabbah bar Avuha, etc. Menachot 32a has Rav Menashya bar Yaakov—or, in another reading, Rav Shmuel bar Yaakov—addressing Rav Chananel’s report of Rav. Hyman consequently places him approximately in Rav Nachman’s generation.

notes.text: The generation estimate belongs to Hyman. The Menashya/Shmuel variation is a first-name variant, not a change in the quoted Rav authority.
